epics.title: Epic 1.1: Backend auth
epics.intro: Email/password + Google OAuth with JWT access tokens and rotating refresh cookies. Design: docs/system-design.md §3.2 (auth module), §5 (API), §8 (security).

issues.title: User table migration (Prisma): id, email, name, role, password_hash, avatar_url, locale
issues.body:
## Context
First real table; unlocks all of Phase 1. Data model in docs/system-design.md §4.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Prisma model + migration committed
- [ ] `role` enum: guest | host | admin (default guest)
- [ ] Unique index on email (case-insensitive)

## Hints
Depends on the Prisma setup issue from Phase 0 (epic 0.1).

issues.title: POST /api/v1/auth/register with zod validation and argon2 hashing
issues.body:
## Context
First auth endpoint, in `modules/auth/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Request schema in packages/shared (email, password ≥8, name)
- [ ] Password hashed with argon2id; never logged or returned
- [ ] Duplicate email → 409 problem+json
- [ ] Tests: happy path, weak password, duplicate

## Hints
Follow the module layout in apps/api/src/modules/README.md.

issues.title: POST /api/v1/auth/login: JWT access token + httpOnly refresh cookie
issues.body:
## Context
Short-lived access token (15 min) in body; refresh token (30 d) as httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Wrong email and wrong password return the SAME 401 (no user enumeration)
- [ ] Access token contains userId + role claims
- [ ] Refresh token persisted (hashed) for revocation
- [ ] Tests for all paths

issues.title: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with rotation + POST /auth/logout
issues.body:
## Context
Refresh rotation: each use invalidates the old token and issues a new one — reuse of a stale token revokes the whole session family.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Valid refresh → new access + new refresh cookie
- [ ] Reused/old refresh → 401 and session family revoked
- [ ] Logout clears cookie and revokes server-side
- [ ] Tests incl. the reuse-detection case

issues.title: Auth middleware + role guard (requireAuth, requireRole)
issues.body:
## Context
Every protected route uses these two middlewares.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `requireAuth` verifies JWT, attaches `req.user`
- [ ] `requireRole('host')` → 403 problem+json when role insufficient
- [ ] Exported from `modules/auth/index.ts` (the module's public interface)
- [ ] Unit tests

issues.title: Google OAuth: authorization-code flow with account linking by email
issues.body:
## Context
"Continue with Google" for tourists who won't create another password.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GET /auth/google → consent redirect; callback exchanges code
- [ ] Existing email → link accounts; new email → create user
- [ ] Issues the same JWT + refresh cookie as password login
- [ ] Secrets via env only (.env.example updated)

## Hints
Use Google's OpenID Connect endpoints directly — no passport needed.

issues.title: Rate limiting on auth endpoints (Redis sliding window)
issues.body:
## Context
Brute-force protection (docs/system-design.md §7).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] register/login/refresh limited per IP (e.g. 10/min) and per email (e.g. 5/min)
- [ ] 429 problem+json with Retry-After header
- [ ] Tests with a fake Redis or testcontainer

issues.title: Integration test: full auth lifecycle (register → login → refresh → logout)
issues.body:
## Context
One test that walks the whole flow catches integration bugs unit tests miss.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Single test file runs the full lifecycle against the real express app + test DB
- [ ] Asserts cookie flags (httpOnly, SameSite)
- [ ] Runs in CI

issues.title: Research: sessions vs JWT — write a 1-page comparison in Discussions
issues.body:
## Context
We chose JWT + refresh rotation. Understand what we gave up.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 1-page post in Discussions → Ideas: server sessions vs JWT (revocation, scaling, complexity)
- [ ] Ends with: when would we switch to sessions?

## Hints
No code. This is how engineers build judgment.

epics.title: Epic 1.2: Users & profiles (backend)
epics.intro: Profile CRUD, avatar upload, become-a-host flow. Design: docs/system-design.md §3.2 (users module).

issues.title: GET and PATCH /api/v1/users/me (name, bio, languages, locale)
issues.body:
## Context
Users manage their own profile in `modules/users/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GET returns own profile (never password_hash — test this!)
- [ ] PATCH validates with shared zod schema; unknown fields rejected
- [ ] 401 without token; tests included

issues.title: Avatar upload to S3-compatible object storage
issues.body:
## Context
First file-upload path — the pattern listings photos will reuse (docs/system-design.md §8).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /users/me/avatar accepts jpeg/png/webp ≤ 2 MB; 415/413 otherwise
- [ ] Stored in object storage (Cloudflare R2/S3); never on the API host
- [ ] avatar_url saved; old avatar deleted
- [ ] Tests with mocked storage client

issues.title: POST /api/v1/users/me/become-host: HostProfile + role upgrade
issues.body:
## Context
Two-sided marketplace: guests upgrade to hosts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Creates HostProfile (about, phone) and sets role=host in one transaction
- [ ] Idempotent: calling twice doesn't duplicate
- [ ] New JWT claims take effect on next refresh; tests

issues.title: GET /api/v1/users/:id — public profile (joined date, languages, listing count)
issues.body:
## Context
What guests see when checking out a host.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Returns ONLY public fields (decide them in the shared schema)
- [ ] 404 problem+json for unknown id
- [ ] Test asserting private fields (email!) are absent

epics.title: Epic 1.3: Frontend auth & profiles
epics.intro: Register/login UI, auth state, protected routes, profile pages.

issues.title: Register and login pages with react-hook-form + shared zod schemas
issues.body:
## Context
The SAME zod schemas validate in the browser and on the server — packages/shared in action.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /register and /login pages, accessible labels + errors
- [ ] Client-side validation from @nomado/shared schemas
- [ ] API errors (409, 401) rendered inline
- [ ] Component tests for validation states

issues.title: Auth provider: token storage, auto-refresh, useAuth() hook
issues.body:
## Context
Central auth state for the whole app.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Access token kept in memory (NOT localStorage — XSS); refresh via cookie on 401 then retry once
- [ ] `useAuth()` exposes user, login, logout, isLoading
- [ ] Logout clears state and calls the API
- [ ] Tests with mocked fetch

issues.title: Protected routes: redirect to /login with return-to
issues.body:
## Context
Trips, profile, host dashboard require login.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unauthenticated visit → /login?next=/original/path
- [ ] After login, user lands on the original page
- [ ] Loading state while auth resolves (no flash of wrong content)

issues.title: "Continue with Google" button + OAuth callback page
issues.body:
## Context
Frontend half of the Google OAuth flow.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Button on register + login pages (Google brand guidelines)
- [ ] /auth/callback handles success and error states
- [ ] Ends fully logged in (auth provider state set)

issues.title: Profile page: view and edit own profile with avatar upload
issues.body:
## Context
First real form-heavy page.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /profile shows current data; edit mode with save/cancel
- [ ] Avatar upload with preview + progress
- [ ] Optimistic update with rollback on error
- [ ] Component tests

issues.title: Public profile page /users/[id]
issues.body:
## Context
Public host/guest profile view.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Renders public profile from API; 404 page for unknown user
- [ ] SSR with proper <title> (SEO matters later — start now)

issues.title: Navbar with auth state: login link vs avatar dropdown menu
issues.body:
## Context
Visible auth state on every page.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Logged out: Login + Sign up buttons
- [ ] Logged in: avatar + dropdown (Profile, Trips, Logout; Host dashboard if role=host)
- [ ] Keyboard accessible; component test for both states

issues.title: Become-a-host onboarding screen
issues.body:
## Context
Front door of the host funnel.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /host/onboarding explains hosting + form (about, phone)
- [ ] Success → host dashboard placeholder; navbar updates to host menu
